name: Abd al-Rahman al-Sa'di
bio: Abd al-Rahman ibn Nasir al-Sa'di was born in 1307 AH in Unayza in the Qasim region of Najd. He taught there as a Hanbali jurist and Qur'an commentator, and founded a library in the town in 1358 AH. His family dates his death to 23 Jumada II 1376 AH (24 January 1957). Al-Zirikli gives the same Hijri year and pairs it with 1956 CE. His works include the Qur'an commentary Taysir al-Karim al-Rahman and books on interpretation and the principles of law, as well as verse his students could commit to memory.
